scenarios.title: RFP Response: Build Media Plan Proposal
scenarios.description: Receive an agency RFP and build a complete media plan proposal with inventory, pricing, audience reach, and phased timeline.
scenarios.query: We received an RFP from Atlas Media for Acme Energy's $2M sustainable energy campaign targeting homeowners 35-65 in CA, TX, AZ, FL, CO. They want CTV, OLV, audio, and display across Q1 2025. Build a media plan proposal with our available inventory, pricing, and audience reach estimates.

scenarios.title: Premium Content Inventory Yield Optimization
scenarios.description: Q: Our Enchanted Kingdoms Season 3 premiere is projected to reach 12.5M viewers. How should we optimize ad load and pricing strategy for premium subscriber satisfaction? Consider family-friendly brand alignment and seasonal demand patterns.
scenarios.query: Our Enchanted Kingdoms Season 3 premiere is projected to reach 12.5M viewers. How should we optimize ad load and pricing strategy for premium subscriber satisfaction? Consider family-friendly brand alignment and seasonal demand patterns.

scenarios.query: The Winter Championship Series expects 28M viewers across 12 events. Develop inventory allocation strategy balancing premium sponsorship opportunities, standard ad slots, and interactive advertising formats while maintaining broadcast quality.

scenarios.query: Balance ad loads across our three subscription tiers (Premium $14.99 ad-free, Standard $7.99 limited ads, Basic $4.99 standard ads) to maximize revenue per user while minimizing churn to competitors offering ad-free alternatives.

scenarios.title: Family Content Brand Safety & Revenue Balance

scenarios.query: Optimize brand safety standards for our G/PG-rated family content while maximizing advertiser appeal. How can we attract premium family-focused brands while maintaining our 98.5% brand safety score and competitive CPMs?

scenarios.title: International Content Localized Advertising Strategy
scenarios.description: Q: Develop advertising strategy for our international content library across different regions. Consider local brand preferences, cultural sensitivities, and regional CPM variations while maintaining global brand safety standards.
scenarios.query: Develop advertising strategy for our international content library across different regions. Consider local brand preferences, cultural sensitivities, and regional CPM variations while maintaining global brand safety standards.

scenarios.title: Ad Stack Waterfall Performance Analysis
scenarios.description: Analyzing ad stack performance to optimize demand partner sequence and timeout settings
scenarios.query: Our current ad stack has Google Ad Manager as primary, followed by StreamVault Media Publisher Services, then Prebid with 8 demand partners. We're seeing 2.3 second average response times and 78% fill rate. Google fills 45% at $8.50 average CPM, StreamVault Media fills 25% at $6.20 CPM, and Prebid fills remaining 30% at $4.80 CPM. Should we reorder our waterfall or adjust timeout settings? Our page load speed target is under 2 seconds and we need to maintain revenue above $35,000 monthly.

scenarios.title: Audience Segmentation Revenue Impact
scenarios.description: Evaluating revenue impact of implementing granular audience segmentation for floor pricing
scenarios.query: We want to implement audience-based floor pricing across our 500K monthly users. Current data shows: returning users (60% of traffic) have 12% higher CTR, mobile users (70% of traffic) have $2 lower average CPM, users from tier-1 cities (40% of traffic) generate 35% more revenue per session. How should we segment our audience for dynamic floor pricing? What floor price adjustments would you recommend for each segment to maximize overall yield while maintaining 80%+ fill rates?

scenarios.title: Ad Placement Layout Revenue Optimization
scenarios.description: Optimizing ad placement positions and sizes to maximize viewability and revenue
scenarios.query: Our current layout has: header banner (728x90) with 95% viewability earning $15 CPM, sidebar banner (300x250) with 60% viewability earning $8 CPM, in-content native ads with 85% viewability earning $12 CPM, and footer banner with 25% viewability earning $4 CPM. We're considering adding a sticky sidebar ad and moving the footer banner higher up. Based on industry benchmarks and our traffic patterns of 2M monthly pageviews, what layout changes would optimize our revenue per visitor?

scenarios.title: Header Bidding Timeout Optimization
scenarios.description: Balancing header bidding timeout settings to optimize revenue vs page performance
scenarios.query: Our header bidding setup includes 12 demand partners with current 1500ms timeout. We're seeing: 85% partners respond within 1000ms averaging $7.20 CPM, 10% respond between 1000-1500ms averaging $9.80 CPM, 5% timeout completely. Our site speed decreased by 0.8 seconds affecting user experience. Should we reduce timeout to 1000ms to improve performance, and what would be the estimated revenue impact on our $50K monthly programmatic revenue?

scenarios.title: Seasonal Floor Price Strategy
scenarios.description: Developing dynamic floor pricing strategy for seasonal traffic and advertiser demand fluctuations
scenarios.query: Historical data shows our Q4 CPMs increase 40% while Q1 drops 25% compared to baseline. Our current static floor prices are: display $8, video $25, native $12. Last Q4 we had 92% fill rate but may have left money on table. This year we expect 30% traffic increase during holiday season. How should we adjust floor prices monthly from October through February to maximize revenue? Include recommendations for different content categories and device types.

scenarios.title: Mobile vs Desktop Yield Gap Analysis
scenarios.description: Analyzing and addressing revenue per visitor gap between mobile and desktop traffic
scenarios.query: Our desktop traffic (30% of total) generates $2.50 RPM while mobile (70% of total) only generates $1.20 RPM. Desktop users view 3.2 pages per session vs 1.8 for mobile. Mobile ad viewability is 15% lower and CPMs are $3 lower on average. We're considering implementing AMP, adding more mobile-optimized ad formats, or adjusting mobile floor prices. What strategy would most effectively close this $0.90 RPM gap and increase our overall monthly revenue from current $28,000?

scenarios.title: Video Ad Placement Yield Optimization
scenarios.description: Optimizing video ad placement strategy to maximize completion rates and CPMs
scenarios.query: Our video content gets 100K monthly views with current pre-roll ads at $35 CPM but only 65% completion rate. We're considering: mid-roll ads (estimated $28 CPM, 80% completion), post-roll ads ($15 CPM, 45% completion), or outstream video in articles ($22 CPM, 70% completion). Our video content averages 4 minutes length. What combination of video ad placements would maximize revenue while maintaining user experience? Include impact analysis on our current $42K monthly video revenue.

scenarios.title: Plan & Discover: Automotive
scenarios.description: Plan budget allocation and discover recommended CTV and digital video inventory with pricing, via the AAMPBuyerAgent.
scenarios.query: Use ONLY your AAMPBuyerAgent for this request. Do not consult any other agent or specialist, and do not use your AdCPBuyerAgent. Ask the AAMPBuyerAgent to plan a $500K Q4 automotive campaign across CTV and digital video targeting adults 25-54 who are in-market for vehicles, allocate budget across channels, and return the recommended inventory with pricing. Present its response together with your agency analysis.

scenarios.title: Plan & Discover: Fintech App
scenarios.description: Plan a mobile app install campaign and see recommended inventory with CPMs, via the AAMPBuyerAgent.
scenarios.query: Use ONLY your AAMPBuyerAgent for this request. Do not consult any other agent or specialist, and do not use your AdCPBuyerAgent. Ask the AAMPBuyerAgent to plan a $250K mobile app install campaign for a fintech budgeting app targeting adults 21-40 across mobile and performance video, allocate the budget across channels, and recommend inventory with CPMs and estimated impressions. Present its response together with your agency analysis.

scenarios.title: Plan & Discover: CPG Brand Awareness
scenarios.description: Plan a premium CTV brand-awareness campaign with a budget split and recommended inventory, via the AAMPBuyerAgent.
scenarios.query: Use ONLY your AAMPBuyerAgent for this request. Do not consult any other agent or specialist, and do not use your AdCPBuyerAgent. Ask the AAMPBuyerAgent to plan a $1M CTV brand-awareness campaign for a CPG snack brand targeting households with children, show the budget split across channels, and return the recommended premium CTV inventory with pricing and audience reach. Present its response together with your agency analysis.

scenarios.title: 1. Sellers & Capabilities
scenarios.description: Ask the buyer which AdCP sales agents it is configured for, and what each one supports (get_adcp_capabilities).
scenarios.query: Which AdCP sales agents are you configured to talk to? For each one, report what it supports via get_adcp_capabilities: the AdCP version it declares, which Media Buy tasks it implements, and whether it also supports the Signals or Accounts protocols. Name each seller explicitly so I know who answered, and if any seller failed to respond say which one rather than leaving it out.

scenarios.title: 2. Discover Inventory
scenarios.description: Run get_products from a natural-language brief with the advertiser's brand, and get product_ids and pricing_option_ids back.
scenarios.query: Discover inventory for a Q4 2026 campaign. Brand domain: acmeenergy.example. Brief: premium CTV and online video reaching environmentally conscious homeowners aged 35-55 in California and Texas, plus sustainability and climate-solutions content. Budget guidance is $750,000 USD, flight 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31. Use buying_mode 'brief'. For every product you return, tell me which seller it came from, the product_id, the pricing_option_id, the pricing model and rate, and the supported formats. Do not blend figures from different sellers into one number.

scenarios.title: 3. Creative Formats
scenarios.description: List the creative formats each seller supports (list_creative_formats) and identify the format_ids a package will need.
scenarios.query: For the products you just recommended, list the creative formats each seller supports for video. I need the format_ids I would pass on a package, with their specs. Flag any product whose required formats we could not fill with a standard 15-second and 30-second video asset, and say which seller each format list came from.

scenarios.title: 4. Declare the Advertiser Account
scenarios.description: sync_accounts at each seller. The brand domain plus operator pair is the account key every later task is scoped to.
scenarios.query: Declare our advertiser account at every seller you work with. Brand domain: acmeenergy.example. Operator: Omnicom Media Group. These two are the account key, so use them verbatim in every later call. Confirm per seller whether the account was created or updated, and report any seller that rejected it.

scenarios.title: 5. Bind Governance to the Sellers
scenarios.description: sync_governance — the seller-side bind step that tells each seller which governance agent owns this buyer's plans.
scenarios.query: Register your governance agent with every seller, for brand domain acmeenergy.example and operator Omnicom Media Group. This is the seller-side bind step: it tells each seller which governance agent owns our plans so it can consult that agent before executing a spend commit. Confirm per seller. If any seller returns ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, name it so we can re-run the account sync for that seller before retrying.

scenarios.title: 6. Register the Campaign Plan
scenarios.description: sync_plans registers budget, flight, authorised channels and markets with the governance agent, so later checks have something to judge against.
scenarios.query: Register the campaign plan with the governance agent. plan_id: plan-acme-q4-2026. Brand domain: acmeenergy.example. Objectives: brand awareness and consideration for residential solar. Total budget: $750,000 USD. Flight: 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31. Authorised channels: ctv, olv, streaming_audio. Authorised markets: country US, regions US-CA and US-TX. Reallocation threshold: 15%. No human-review requirement and no custom policies on this plan. Report exactly what the sync returned, and be clear that registering a plan is not approval of anything.

scenarios.title: 7. Authorize the Buy (Intent Check)
scenarios.description: check_governance before any spend commit. The payload mirrors the full create_media_buy body so every governed dimension is actually checked.
scenarios.query: Before we spend anything, run the intent-phase governance check for the buy we are about to place on plan plan-acme-q4-2026. Scope it to the seller that owns the first product you recommended, with tool_name create_media_buy, and a payload that mirrors the FULL create_media_buy body — not just a budget: the package with its product_id, budget and pricing_option_id, the flight window as start_time 2026-10-01 and end_time 2026-12-31, and a targeting_overlay with geo_countries ['US'] and geo_regions ['US-CA','US-TX']. Report the verdict, the check_id, and whether a governance_context token was issued. If the verdict is 'conditions', list the conditions and treat it as NOT approved.

scenarios.title: 8. Book the Media Buy
scenarios.description: create_media_buy against the approved seller and product, carrying the governance_context from the authorising check.
scenarios.query: Book it. Create the media buy against the seller and product from the approved check, presenting that check's governance_context. Commit $250,000 USD of the plan's budget, use the pricing_option_id from the product, brand domain acmeenergy.example, operator Omnicom Media Group, flight 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31, and idempotency key acme-q4-2026-ctv-pkg-001. Report the media_buy_id, the seller's confirmed budget, the creative deadline, and the package status. If the seller returns 'submitted' rather than a confirmation, say so and give me the task handle instead of implying the buy is live. These are sandbox sellers, so state that no real money moved.

scenarios.title: 9. Close the Governance Loop
scenarios.description: report_plan_outcome with the seller's actual confirmed budget, so the plan's tracked spend matches reality.
scenarios.query: Close the governance loop for plan plan-acme-q4-2026. Report the outcome of that booking with outcome 'completed', the check_id that authorised it, the governance_context, the seller reference, and the seller's ACTUAL confirmed budget from its response — never the amount we originally requested, since a seller may confirm a different figure. Confirm the plan's tracked budget now reflects the commitment.

scenarios.title: 10. Idempotent Retry
scenarios.description: Re-send the same create_media_buy with the same idempotency_key and confirm the seller returns the existing buy instead of double-booking.
scenarios.query: Re-send the exact same create_media_buy for idempotency key acme-q4-2026-ctv-pkg-001 — same seller, product, pricing option, budget and flight. AdCP specifies that a repeated idempotency key for the same account returns the EXISTING media buy rather than creating a second one. Tell me whether you got the same media_buy_id back, and confirm no duplicate buy and no duplicate commitment were created. If the seller instead created a second buy, report that as a conformance problem on the seller's side.

scenarios.title: 11. Delivery & Operational Status
scenarios.description: get_media_buy_delivery for billing-grade figures, get_media_buys for operational status and creative-approval state.
scenarios.query: Report on the media buy we booked. Give me the billing-grade delivery figures, and separately the operational status and creative-approval state. Say which task produced which figure, and treat the billing-grade delivery numbers as the authoritative ones. These sellers are sandbox accounts, so if little or no delivery has been recorded yet, say that plainly rather than implying delivery that has not happened.

scenarios.title: 12. Plan Audit Trail
scenarios.description: get_plan_audit_logs reads back the governance agent's own record of every check and outcome on the plan.
scenarios.query: Show me the audit trail the governance agent recorded for plan plan-acme-q4-2026, including entries. I want the intent check and its verdict, the booking outcome, and the plan's current tracked budget and lifecycle status. Read this back from the governance agent rather than re-deriving it from our conversation.

scenarios.title: 13. Governance Denial: Out-of-Market Buy
scenarios.description: Attempt a buy targeting a market the plan never authorised, and show the governance agent refusing it.
scenarios.query: We have a request to extend the campaign into Canada. Run the governance check for an additional $100,000 USD buy on plan plan-acme-q4-2026 against the same seller and product, tool_name create_media_buy, flight 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31, with targeting_overlay geo_countries ['CA']. The plan authorises only US, US-CA and US-TX, so I expect this to be denied. Report the verdict and the governance agent's stated reason. Do NOT send anything to the seller, and do not resize or retarget the buy to get it through — the boundary is the plan's, not yours to move.

scenarios.title: Compile Visual Media Plan

Synthesize market-by-market allocation (Germany, UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium), format mix (CTV, digital video, native), phased timeline (awareness through peak conversion), pricing summary, and audience reach projections into a structured media plan document.
